segments.name: Greens Creek
products: silver, zinc, and precious metals flotation concentrates
gravity concentrate containing payable silver, gold and lead
segments.description: Underground mine on Admiralty Island near Juneau, Alaska producing silver, gold, lead and zinc concentrates sold to custom smelters and metal traders.
segments.evidence: Greens Creek located on Admiralty Island, near Juneau, Alaska - 100% owned and has been in production since 1989.

segments.name: Lucky Friday
segments.description: Underground mine in northern Idaho producing silver, zinc and lead flotation concentrates sold to custom smelters and metal traders.
segments.evidence: Lucky Friday located in northern Idaho - 100% owned and has been a producing mine for us since 1958.

segments.name: Keno Hill
products: silver and precious metal flotation concentrates
segments.description: Silver mine in Canada's Yukon Territory in ramp-up, producing silver and precious metal flotation concentrates below commercial production levels.
segments.evidence: Keno Hill is currently in ramp-up and producing silver and precious metal flotation concentrates, but at less than what we consider to be commercial production levels.

segments.name: Casa Berardi
products: unrefined gold and silver bullion bars (doré)
segments.description: Mine in the Abitibi region of northwestern Quebec producing gold and silver doré, loaded carbon and precipitates shipped to refiners.
segments.evidence: Casa Berardi located in the Abitibi region of northwestern Quebec, Canada - 100% owned and has been in production since late 2006.

revenueModel.text: Hecla is paid by custom smelters, metal traders, third-party processors and refiners for the payable metals contained in its concentrates, carbon material and doré.
revenueModel.evidence: The silver, zinc and precious metals concentrates and carbon material we produce are sold to custom smelters, metal traders and third-party processors, and the unrefined doré we produce is sold to refiners or further refined before sale of the metals to traders.

changes.text: In 2026, Hecla announced an agreement to sell its subsidiary owning the Casa Berardi operation to Orezone Gold Corporation, expected to close in the first quarter of 2026.
changes.evidence: On January 26, 2026, following a review of how Casa Berardi fits into our future strategy, we announced that we entered into a material definitive agreement to sell our wholly-owned subsidiary Hecla Quebec Inc., which owns the Casa Berardi operation to Orezone Gold Corporation ("Orezone") for up to $593 million in total consideration
